env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild

exclude='\(/_\|examples\|Godeps\|testdata'
if [[ -n "$excludedPackages" ]]; then
  IFS=' ' read -r -a excludedArr <<<"${excludedPackages[@]}"
  printf -v excludedAlternates '%s\\|' "${excludedArr[@]}"
  excludedAlternates=${excludedAlternates%\\|} # drop final \| added by printf
  exclude+='\|'"$excludedAlternates"
fi
exclude+='\)'

buildGoDir() {
  local cmd="$1" dir="$2"

  declare -a flags
  flags+=(${tags:+-tags=$(concatStringsSep "," tags)})
  flags+=(${ldflags:+-ldflags="${ldflags[*]}"})
  flags+=("-p" "$NIX_BUILD_CORES")
  if (( "${NIX_DEBUG:-0}" >= 1 )); then
    flags+=(-x)
  fi

  if [ "$cmd" = "test" ]; then
    flags+=(-vet=off)
    flags+=($checkFlags)
  fi

  local OUT
  if ! OUT="$(go $cmd "${flags[@]}" $dir 2>&1)"; then
    if ! echo "$OUT" | grep -qE '(no( buildable| non-test)?|build constraints exclude all) Go (source )?files'; then
      echo "$OUT" >&2
      return 1
    fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then
    echo "$OUT" >&2
  fi
  return 0
}

getGoDirs() {
  local type;
  type="$1"
  if [ -n "$subPackages" ]; then
    echo "$subPackages" | sed "s,\(^\| \),\1./,g"
  else
    find . -type f -name \*$type.go -exec dirname {} \; | grep -v "/vendor/" | sort --unique | grep -v "$exclude"
  fi
}

if [ -z "$enableParallelBuilding" ]; then
    export NIX_BUILD_CORES=1
fi
for pkg in $(getGoDirs ""); do
  echo "Building subPackage $pkg"
buildGoDir install "$pkg"

done
runHook postBuild
env.checkPhase:
runHook preCheck
/nix/store/5a0h3d6488628sh6w1ccqk8dizvmp8ji-python3-3.13.15-env/bin/python3 test/codex_protocol_contract.py \
  --coverage-only codex/client.go
go test ./...
/nix/store/viadyk3hg56ib6vky4cm3sb2y3n305aw-nodejs-24.19.0/bin/node --check conversation/assets/conversation.js
/nix/store/viadyk3hg56ib6vky4cm3sb2y3n305aw-nodejs-24.19.0/bin/node --test test/conversation_browser_contract_test.cjs test/uploads_browser_contract_test.cjs test/sync_browser_contract_test.cjs test/refresh_browser_contract_test.cjs test/questions_browser_contract_test.cjs test/citations_browser_contract_test.cjs
runHook postCheck
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure

export GOCACHE=$TMPDIR/go-cache
export GOPATH="$TMPDIR/go"
export GOPROXY=off
export GOSUMDB=off
if [ -f "$NIX_CC_FOR_TARGET/nix-support/dynamic-linker" ]; then
  export GO_LDSO=$(cat $NIX_CC_FOR_TARGET/nix-support/dynamic-linker)
fi
cd "$modRoot"
rm -rf vendor
cp -r --reflink=auto "$goModules" vendor

runHook postConfigure
